title: your FOOD has been lying to you 🍓 | part 7
hook: Your food has been lying to you.
facts: Strawberries are not berries. But bananas are.
White chocolate contains no actual chocolate solids.
Ketchup was once sold as medicine.
Bell peppers have more vitamin C than oranges.
Honey is basically nectar that bees swallowed and brought back up.
outro: Follow for part eight. Dinner will never recover.
